description.text: In near-total darkness, the dimly lit nose of the
sits still, not yet moving. Faint highlights trace the edge of the grille and the curve of the bodywork, while the surrounding space falls away into black.
pulls forward out of the dark, rolling into a dim pool of light. The shadowed background recedes as the bodywork catches faint reflections and the grille emerges into view.

subjects.description: A car, initially hidden in darkness, with a dimly lit nose and grille.

claims.text: The car pulls forward out of the dark.
The supplied audio reference is a low engine rumble.
Faint highlights pick out the grille and bodywork in near-darkness.
A dim pool of light reveals the car as it moves forward.
